text: 法德利差再破150基点，法国国债正在被重新“开价” 法国社会动荡叠加高债务、财政赤字及拥挤交易等多重因素，正触发市场对法国主权债的重新定价。
text_en: France-Germany spread breaks 150 basis points again as French government bonds are being repriced. Social unrest in France, combined with high debt, fiscal deficits and crowded trades, is triggering a market repricing of French sovereign debt.
